title: Modeling Deontic Modal Logic in the s(CASP) Goal-directed Predicate Answer Set Programming System
reasoning: The paper is entirely dedicated to modeling Deontic Modal Logic, which is the logic of normative concepts such as obligation, permission, and impermissibility. It evaluates its logic system by demonstrating how it resolves classical ethical and moral reasoning paradoxes, including the 'Gentle Killer' (Forrester's Paradox), Chisholm's Paradox, and Sartre's Dilemma.
